title: Last Circle
short_description: A 50-player battle royale with Fortnite-style building — drop onto one of three maps, loot, farm, build, and outlive 49 fiercely competitive opponents as the storm closes in.
description: Last Circle is a full third-person battle royale in the browser. Every match is a 50-player lobby — you plus 49 AI opponents that loot, farm materials, rotate with the storm, take cover, box up, ramp-push, and fight like real players (friends can join over the network and instantly replace a bot). Three distinct maps — the vibrant tropical Isla Viva, the shattered downtown of Ashgrid, and the deep conifer wilds of Deepwood — each with unique POIs, loot, and high ground. Full building system: walls, floors, ramps, and stairs in wood, brick, and metal, with edits and harvesting. Assault rifles, shotguns, snipers, SMGs, pistols, rockets, and grenades, with shields, chests, supply drops, and a shrinking storm. Standard, 5-minute Quick, and Practice modes.
controls_keyboard: WASD move · Mouse aim/fire · RMB ADS · SPACE jump · CTRL crouch · SHIFT sprint · E interact · R reload · Z/X/C/V build wall/floor/ramp/stair · G edit · 1-5 slots · TAB inventory · M map
